name: Technology
description: Build the software, infrastructure, and intelligent systems the modern world runs on. The widest, fastest-moving career domain of our time.

name: Healthcare
description: Diagnose, treat, and protect human health — from individual patients in the clinic to entire populations in the field.

name: Business
description: Build, run, and grow organizations. Every industry needs strategy, marketing, operations, and people.

name: Finance
description: Move, protect, and grow capital. Where mathematics, markets, and high-stakes decisions converge.

name: Creative Arts
description: Design, produce, and perform work that shapes culture, communication, and the human experience.

name: Sciences
description: Study the natural world from molecules to galaxies. Discoveries here become the medicine, technology, and policy of tomorrow.

name: Social Sciences and Law
description: Understand, govern, and improve human society — from individual psychology to international systems and the law that holds them together.

name: Engineering
description: Design and build the physical systems civilization depends on — from bridges to spacecraft to electric grids.

name: Trades, Vocational, and Emerging
description: Hands-on, human-centered, and increasingly well-compensated. From licensed trades to frontier industries, these paths are building the next economy.

name: Software Development
description: Write the code that powers the apps, services, and platforms billions of people use every day.

name: AI and Data
description: Build intelligent systems and extract insight from data — the engineering behind every machine that thinks, predicts, and recommends.

name: Infrastructure and Security
description: Keep software running reliably, securely, and at scale. The discipline that separates production systems from demos.

name: Product and Design
description: Define what gets built, shape how it looks, and make sure it actually works for real people.

name: Emerging Technology
description: Robotics, immersive environments, decentralized systems — the categories that don't fully exist yet but will define the next decade.

name: Frontend Development
description: You build what people actually see and click. Every interface, interaction, and layout on the web starts with you.

name: Backend Development
description: The invisible engine behind every app. You design the APIs, services, and databases that make everything on the surface work.

name: Full-Stack Development
description: You own the product from interface to infrastructure — the closest thing to building something completely on your own.

name: Mobile Development
description: The apps people reach for first thing in the morning. You build experiences that live in someone's pocket, always within reach.

name: Blockchain Development
description: You build decentralized systems and smart contracts — the infrastructure for programmable, trustless digital transactions.

name: AR / VR / XR Development
description: You build immersive environments where digital and physical space merge — from training simulations to games to virtual workspaces.

name: No-Code / Low-Code Development
description: You build powerful apps, automations, and workflows without traditional code — making software creation accessible to entirely new groups of people.

name: AI / Machine Learning Engineering
description: You teach machines to learn, recognize, and decide. The field reshaping every industry, actively, right now.

name: Prompt Engineering
description: You design the inputs that shape AI outputs — the discipline of communicating with language models to build reliable, production-grade AI features.

name: Data Science
description: You find the signal in the noise. Patterns buried in millions of data points become decisions that change how organizations operate.

name: Data Engineering
description: You build the pipelines and infrastructure that make data usable in the first place. Without you, data science cannot exist.

name: Data Analysis
description: You turn raw numbers into decisions. Every business and government in the world runs on the clarity data analysts provide.

name: DevOps / Platform Engineering
description: You make sure software ships reliably and runs at scale — the bridge between writing code and running it in production.

name: Cloud Architecture
description: You design the infrastructure modern software lives on. Scalable, resilient, and always available.

name: Cybersecurity
description: You defend systems, networks, and people from threats that grow more sophisticated every year. One of the most critical and understaffed roles in 2026.

name: Cybersecurity Analysis
description: You investigate attacks, trace breaches, and protect infrastructure after threats get through. Equal parts detective and engineer.

name: IT Systems Administration
description: You keep the technology of organizations running. The expert everyone calls when everything stops working.

name: Embedded Systems / IoT
description: You write code that runs inside physical devices — cars, sensors, medical hardware, smart appliances. The software the world runs on invisibly.

name: UI / UX Design
description: You make digital products easier, more human, and more intuitive. Design is not decoration — it is the product.

name: Product Management
description: You decide what gets built and why. You connect user needs, business goals, and engineering reality into something real.

name: AI Product Management
description: You bring AI-powered products from idea to launch — understanding both what the model can do and what users actually need.

name: Technical Writing
description: You translate complexity into clarity. The person who makes powerful tools actually usable by real people.

name: QA / Test Engineering
description: You find what breaks before users do. The discipline that separates professional software from amateur builds.

name: Game Development
description: You build the worlds people escape into — writing the code behind physics, AI, rendering, and real-time interactivity.

name: Robotics Engineering
description: You build machines that sense, move, and act in the physical world. The field defining what the next economy looks like.

name: Drone and UAV Technology
description: You design, operate, or program unmanned systems used in delivery, agriculture, emergency response, and surveillance.

name: Mental Health Technology
description: You build the apps and platforms that scale access to mental health support — where software engineering meets human empathy.

name: Fintech Development
description: You build the next generation of banking, payments, and financial tools — where software engineering meets the movement of money.

name: Clinical Medicine
description: Direct patient care — diagnosis, treatment, and the relationship at the heart of medicine.

name: Nursing and Allied Health
description: The clinical professionals working closest to patients every day — from bedside care to rehabilitation, imaging, and nutrition.

name: Mental Health and Psychiatry
description: The professionals who treat the mind — therapy, medication, and the science of human psychology working together.

name: Biomedical and Research
description: The laboratory, research, and technology infrastructure that makes modern medicine possible.

name: Medicine (General Practice)
description: You are often the first person someone trusts with their health — long-term patient relationships and the weight of diagnosis, every day.

name: Pharmacy
description: You are the expert on what goes into the body and why. Medication safety, precise dosing, and patient counseling at the point of care.

name: Dentistry
description: You give people something they use every day without thinking about: a healthy, functional, confident smile.

name: Optometry
description: You protect and restore the sense people rely on most. The difference between struggling and seeing clearly.

name: Veterinary Medicine
description: You care for animals that cannot tell you where it hurts. Diagnostic skill and genuine compassion required in equal measure.

name: Emergency Medicine / Paramedicine
description: You treat people in the worst moments of their lives — fast, in unpredictable conditions, when every minute matters.

name: Midwifery
description: You guide and protect one of the most significant experiences in a person's life — from pregnancy through birth and into early parenthood.

name: Nursing
description: You are the most constant presence in a patient's care — clinical skill, genuine emotional intelligence, and real human connection every single shift.

name: Physiotherapy
description: You help people move again after injury, illness, or surgery. Recovery is deeply personal, and you are at the center of it.

name: Occupational Therapy
description: You help people reclaim independence in daily life after illness or disability. Practical, compassionate, and genuinely life-changing work.

name: Radiography / Medical Imaging
description: You see inside the body without opening it. Your images guide diagnoses and surgical decisions across every hospital, every day.

name: Nutrition and Dietetics
description: You translate the science of food into personal guidance that changes how people feel and live. A field growing as health literacy deepens.

name: Speech-Language Pathology
description: You help people communicate and swallow again after stroke, injury, or developmental difficulty — a career that restores one of the most fundamental human connections.

name: Clinical Psychology
description: You help people understand and change their own minds. One of the most human and genuinely impactful disciplines there is.

name: Psychiatry
description: You treat mental illness with the full weight of medical science. Stigma is decreasing and demand is growing faster than the supply of practitioners.

name: Mental Health and Addiction Counseling
description: You support people navigating addiction, trauma, and mental health crisis — at the intersection of clinical skill and genuine human compassion.

name: Biomedical Science
description: You run the laboratory tests that underpin almost every clinical decision. Medicine would not function without you behind the scenes.

name: Neuroscience
description: You study the most complex object in the known universe: the human brain. Biology, psychology, and technology converging in one field.

name: Public Health
description: You protect entire populations, not just individual patients — policy, prevention, and systems thinking at a scale most careers never reach.

name: Biomedical Engineering
description: You design and build the devices medicine depends on — pacemakers, prosthetics, imaging systems, and surgical tools.

name: Health Informatics
description: You connect clinical knowledge with technology to make healthcare systems smarter, faster, and safer for everyone inside them.

name: Strategy and Consulting
description: Shape what organizations do and how they do it. The highest-leverage thinking roles in business.

name: Marketing and Growth
description: Drive how people discover, feel about, and choose products and brands. Part science, part creativity, always people-focused.

name: Operations and Logistics
description: Keep the systems of commerce functioning — supply chains, movement of goods, and the machinery of delivery at scale.

name: Entrepreneurship
description: Build something from nothing. The most uncertain, most personal, and potentially most impactful path in business.

name: People and Organisation
description: Hire, develop, and protect the culture and people that make organizations work.

name: Business Analysis
description: You translate between business problems and technical solutions — the person who asks the right questions before anything gets built.

name: Management Consulting
description: You solve complex business problems for organizations that cannot see their own blind spots. Every industry, every kind of challenge.

name: Project Management
description: You deliver things on time, within scope, and under budget. The discipline that turns ideas into real outcomes.

name: Sustainability Consulting
description: You help organizations reduce environmental and social impact in ways that are commercially viable. One of the fastest-growing advisory careers.

name: Marketing
description: You shape how people discover, feel about, and connect with things that matter to them. Part science, part creativity, always people-focused.

name: Digital Marketing
description: SEO, paid media, content, social strategy — you drive how brands grow online. Measurable, always evolving, never the same twice.

name: Brand Strategy
description: You define what an organization stands for and how it expresses that to the world — the thinking behind every brand that feels coherent and true.

name: E-commerce and Retail Strategy
description: You design and optimize how products move from warehouse to doorstep. One of the fastest-growing commercial sectors in the world.

name: Supply Chain Management
description: You keep the global flow of goods moving. A field that became visibly critical to the whole world when it broke down in 2020.

name: Logistics and Operations
description: You make sure the systems of commerce actually function. Behind every on-time delivery and every well-run business.

name: Real Estate
description: Property as a business — investment, development, and the commercial strategy behind where people live, work, and spend money.

name: Sales and Business Development
description: You open doors, build relationships, and bring in revenue — the role every organization needs and few do really well.

name: General Entrepreneurship
description: You build something from nothing. The most uncertain, most personal, and potentially most impactful path there is.

name: E-commerce Entrepreneurship
description: You build and run a product-based business in the digital-first economy. Lower barrier to entry than ever — still requires everything.

name: Human Resources
description: You build and protect the culture and people of an organization — strategy, empathy, and genuinely difficult decisions in equal measure.

name: Investment and Markets
description: Analyze, price, and move capital at the intersection of companies, markets, and high-stakes strategy.

name: Financial Planning and Advisory
description: Help individuals and organizations protect and grow their wealth across a lifetime.

name: Risk and Insurance
description: Quantify, price, and manage uncertainty — the mathematical backbone of financial stability.

name: Investment Banking
description: High-stakes deal-making at the intersection of capital, companies, and markets. Demanding, fast-moving, and highly impactful.

name: Financial Analysis
description: You make sense of numbers to guide investment, strategy, and critical decisions — where mathematics meets business judgment.

name: Actuarial Science
description: You quantify risk using mathematics and probability — applied to insurance, pensions, and policy at the highest professional level.

name: Financial Planning and Wealth Management
description: You help individuals and families build financial security over a lifetime — goal-setting, investing, tax strategy, and long-term trust.

name: Insurance and Risk Management
description: You help organizations understand and protect against what could go wrong — pricing uncertainty and building resilience into business strategy.

name: Visual Design
description: Shape how things look — from brand identities and illustrations to interfaces and product aesthetics.

name: Media and Production
description: Create the content that fills screens, speakers, and feeds — video, audio, games, and the channels between.

name: Architecture and Spatial Design
description: Design the buildings, spaces, and objects people inhabit, use, and love every day.

name: Writing and Content
description: Communicate with words — journalism, storytelling, UX copy, and everything the written word can do.

name: Performing Arts
description: Live performance, movement, and the stage. The oldest and most immediate form of human expression.

name: Graphic Design
description: You give ideas a visual form that communicates instantly. Every brand, campaign, and layout that has ever stopped someone in their tracks starts here.

name: Illustration and Concept Art
description: You create original visual worlds — from editorial illustration to the concept art that defines the look of games, films, and brands.

name: Animation and Motion Graphics
description: You bring still things to life. Film, advertising, games, and education all depend on what you can make move.

name: Photography
description: You capture moments, people, products, and places in a frame that outlasts you. Artistic, commercial, and journalistic all at once.

name: UI / UX Research
description: You find out how real people actually experience technology and feed that truth back into the design process. Evidence-based creativity.

name: Fashion Design
description: You dress people and reflect culture back at itself — where craft, identity, commerce, and self-expression all meet.

name: Film and Video Production
description: You tell stories through moving images — from documentary to short-form content, you control what people see and feel.

name: Music Production
description: You build the sound that sits underneath culture. Tracks, film scores, game audio, podcast beds — everything has a sound designer behind it.

name: Sound Design and Audio Engineering
description: You build the acoustic world — for film, music, live events, and games. Invisible work with enormous emotional impact.

name: Podcast Production
description: Long-form audio storytelling for audiences who choose to spend an hour with a voice they trust. An intimate, growing, and monetizable medium.

name: Social Media Content Creation
description: You communicate directly to audiences at scale, without intermediaries — a creative career that did not exist twenty years ago and now drives culture.

name: Game Design
description: You design the systems and experiences of play — mechanics, narrative, and player psychology in a discipline that millions choose over everything else.

name: Architecture
description: You design buildings that will outlast you by a century. Shelter, beauty, function, and identity built into permanent physical structures.

name: Interior Design
description: You shape the spaces people live and work in every day. Every room someone loves is a room someone designed.

name: Industrial / Product Design
description: You design the objects people hold, use, and love — from furniture to medical devices to the phone in everyone's hand.

name: Journalism and Creative Writing
description: You tell the stories that inform, challenge, and change how people think. A field that has never been more necessary or more contested.

name: UX Writing and Content Design
description: You write the words inside products — buttons, onboarding flows, error messages, tooltips. The difference between an app that confuses and one that guides.

name: Theatre and Performing Arts
description: You perform live, in the room, for real people. The oldest human art form and still one of the most viscerally powerful.

name: Dance and Choreography
description: You communicate through movement — in performance, education, film, and live events. Physical storytelling at its most direct.

name: Life Sciences
description: Study living organisms — from the genetics of a single cell to the ecology of entire ecosystems.

name: Physical Sciences
description: Understand matter, energy, and the universe itself at the most fundamental level.

name: Earth and Environmental Sciences
description: Study the planet — its history, its systems, and the forces threatening them right now.

name: Applied Sciences
description: Put scientific knowledge to practical use — in food, forensics, agriculture, and the systems that sustain civilization.

name: Marine Biology
description: You study the ocean, which covers most of Earth and is least understood. Research that shapes conservation and policy for the entire planet.

name: Biotechnology
description: You use living systems to solve problems in medicine, agriculture, and materials. The frontier of applied biology in 2026.

name: Genetics and Genomics
description: You decode the instructions written into DNA — driving breakthroughs in medicine, agriculture, and our understanding of life itself.

name: Ecology
description: You study how living systems interact and depend on each other — the science behind conservation, climate response, and environmental policy.

name: Conservation Biology
description: You fight for the survival of species and ecosystems — field work, research, and policy advocacy as a single professional life.

name: Microbiology and Immunology
description: You study the smallest organisms and the body's defenses against them — at the center of vaccine development, infectious disease, and drug discovery.

name: Chemistry
description: You understand matter at its most fundamental level. Pharmaceuticals, materials, energy, and food all depend on chemists.

name: Physics
description: You ask the deepest questions about reality and use mathematics to answer them — the foundation of all applied science and engineering.

name: Astronomy and Astrophysics
description: You study the universe beyond Earth. One of the few careers where genuine wonder is a professional requirement.

name: Materials Science
description: You discover and engineer new substances — lighter aircraft, faster chips, more flexible solar panels. Everything improves when materials do.

name: Environmental Science
description: You study and defend the systems all life depends on — climate, soil, water, air. This work has never mattered more in human history.

name: Geology
description: You read the history of Earth in rock and sediment — essential for energy, mining, natural disaster prediction, and climate science.

name: Forensic Science
description: You bring scientific method to criminal justice. Evidence that determines outcomes in court — the stakes could not be higher.

name: Food Science and Technology
description: You improve how food is made, preserved, and delivered safely to billions of people. A deeply practical and growing field.

name: Agricultural Science
description: You improve how we grow food in a changing climate. Feeding humanity without destroying the planet is the defining challenge of this century.

name: Law and Governance
description: The rules that hold society together — and the people who write, argue, enforce, and reform them.

name: Social and Behavioral Sciences
description: Understand why people think, feel, behave, and form societies the way they do.

name: International and Public Affairs
description: Navigate the space between nations, governments, and global institutions.

name: Education and Information
description: Teach, guide, and organize knowledge — the infrastructure of human understanding.

name: Humanities
description: Study language, ideas, culture, and the past — the disciplines that ask the deepest questions about what it means to be human.

name: Law
description: You understand, argue, and defend the rules that hold society together. Every major human conflict and every significant transaction has a legal dimension.

name: Criminology
description: You study crime, its causes, and how justice systems respond — connecting research, policy, and rehabilitation in one discipline.

name: Urban Planning
description: You design cities. Where people live, how they move, what they can afford — decisions made by urban planners, felt by everyone.

name: Cybersecurity Policy and Law
description: You work at the intersection of government, law, and technology — shaping how nations protect their digital infrastructure at a systemic level.

name: Psychology
description: You study why people think, feel, and behave as they do. Applicable to every human field there is — nothing works better without it.

name: Sociology
description: You study society as a system — how groups form, what norms sustain them, and what forces eventually break them down.

name: Economics
description: You model how resources, incentives, and decisions shape the world. Policy, finance, research, and business all run on economic thinking.

name: Social Work
description: You support people in the hardest moments of their lives. A demanding, essential, and deeply human profession.

name: Counseling
description: You create space for people to process, heal, and move forward — in schools, hospitals, community settings, and private practice.

name: Anthropology
description: You study what it means to be human across cultures, time periods, and societies — the broadest possible lens on the human story.

name: Political Science and Policy
description: You study power, governance, and the systems that organize societies. The foundation for careers in government, NGOs, and international affairs.

name: International Relations
description: You navigate the space between nations, cultures, and global institutions — diplomacy, development, and geopolitics as a daily reality.

name: Education and Teaching
description: You shape how the next generation understands the world. One of the few careers where your impact multiplies through every person you teach.

name: Library and Information Science
description: You organize, preserve, and connect people to knowledge — increasingly critical in an age of information overload and AI-generated content.

name: Linguistics
description: You study language itself — how it works, evolves, and shapes thought. Applied to AI, translation, communication, and education.

name: Philosophy
description: You study the foundations of knowledge, ethics, and reality — applied today to AI ethics, law, policy, and the hardest questions in science.

name: Archaeology
description: You recover the physical record of human history — excavating the past to understand how civilizations rose, changed, and fell.

name: Civil and Structural
description: Design and build the permanent physical infrastructure that cities and civilization depend on.

name: Mechanical and Automotive
description: Engineer the machines, vehicles, and physical systems that move people and power industry.

name: Electrical and Electronic Systems
description: Work with electricity, electronics, and the systems that power everything from homes to satellites.

name: Chemical and Nuclear
description: Transform matter and energy at industrial and molecular scales — from pharmaceuticals to power generation.

name: Aerospace
description: Design aircraft and spacecraft — among the most technically demanding and highest-stakes work in any engineering discipline.

name: Environmental and Energy
description: Engineer the systems that manage the planet's most critical resources — clean water, clean energy, and clean air.

name: Civil Engineering
description: You build the infrastructure people depend on every day — bridges, roads, water systems, flood defenses. Permanent and visible impact.

name: Structural Engineering
description: You calculate whether buildings stand or fall. Safety, precision, and the literal weight of responsibility in every project.

name: Mechanical Engineering
description: You design machines and physical systems — from vehicle engines to manufacturing equipment to mechanisms inside medical devices.

name: Automotive and EV Engineering
description: You design the vehicles and powertrains of the electric era. A century-old industry in the middle of its biggest transformation.

name: Industrial and Manufacturing Engineering
description: You optimize the systems that make things at scale — cutting waste, improving output, and keeping production lines running.

name: Electrical Engineering
description: You work with power, electronics, and the systems that run everything from homes to satellites to electric grids.

name: Chemical Engineering
description: You scale up chemistry into industrial processes — energy, pharmaceuticals, food production, and materials manufacturing at real-world scale.

name: Nuclear Engineering
description: You design systems that harness nuclear energy — from power generation to medical imaging. A field in significant resurgence as clean energy demand grows.

name: Aerospace Engineering
description: You design aircraft and spacecraft — one of the most technically demanding fields with among the highest stakes of any profession.

name: Environmental Engineering
description: You engineer solutions to pollution, waste, and water quality — applying engineering discipline directly to the sustainability crisis.

name: Renewable Energy Engineering
description: You design solar, wind, battery, and grid systems. The engineering challenge and the commercial opportunity of the entire 21st century.

name: Food and Hospitality
description: Create the experiences people plan months for and remember for years — from professional kitchens to global tourism.

name: Skilled Trades and Construction
description: Build, install, and maintain the physical world — the licensed professionals every functioning building and city needs.

name: Fitness and Wellness
description: Guide people toward lasting physical and mental health through evidence-based training, coaching, and lifestyle support.

name: Entertainment and Events
description: Produce the moments, competitions, and live experiences that define how people spend their leisure time.

name: Education and Youth Development
description: Shape the minds of the youngest learners and build the tools that make education more effective and accessible.

name: Emerging and Frontier
description: The industries and technologies that barely existed a decade ago and will define the careers of the next generation.

name: Culinary Arts
description: You master fire, knife, flavor, and timing. Professional kitchens are among the most demanding environments in any field — and produce something beautiful.

name: Hospitality and Tourism Management
description: You create the experiences people save money and plan months for. The world's largest service industry.

name: Skilled Trades (Electrician, Plumber, HVAC)
description: You keep the physical world functioning. Skilled, licensed, essential, and increasingly well-compensated as shortages grow.

name: Real Estate Agency
description: You help people make one of the largest financial decisions of their lives — market knowledge, negotiation, and trust at the center.

name: Construction Management
description: You oversee the projects that physically build cities — coordinating teams, budgets, timelines, and safety on everything from homes to skyscrapers.

name: Beauty and Cosmetology
description: You work directly with people to help them look and feel their best — a creative, client-centered, and deeply personal career.

name: Sports Science and Coaching
description: You apply physiology, psychology, and biomechanics to athletic performance. Behind every elite result is a sports science team.

name: Personal Training and Fitness
description: You guide people through physical transformation — increasingly evidence-based, increasingly in demand, and deeply personal work.

name: Health and Wellness Coaching
description: You guide people toward sustainable changes in how they live, sleep, eat, and move. The line between coaching and healthcare is narrowing.

name: Event Management
description: You produce the moments people remember for years — from concerts and corporate summits to weddings and sporting events.

name: Esports and Gaming Industry
description: You work in competition management, broadcasting, analytics, or event production in one of the world's fastest-growing entertainment sectors.

name: Early Childhood Education
description: You shape people at the age when they are most impressionable. Research consistently shows this is the highest-leverage point in human development.

name: EdTech and Learning Design
description: You build the tools and curricula that change how people learn — technology-led education at a scale no classroom ever reached.

name: Space Technology
description: You build systems for the new era of commercial spaceflight, satellite infrastructure, and deep-space exploration — a field accelerating faster than any other.

name: Human-Computer Interaction (HCI)
description: You research how people interact with technology and design systems that work with human cognition instead of against it.
